formats.name: text_post
formats.notes: 500 chars; emojis count by UTF-8 bytes; up to 5 unique links; link attachment text-only posts

formats.name: text_attachment
formats.notes: up to 10000 chars plus one link; text-only posts, not with polls; styling bold/italic/highlight/underline/strikethrough

formats.name: video
formats.notes: MOV/MP4, H.264 or HEVC, AAC, 23-60 fps, max width 1920, ratio 0.01:1 to 10:1

formats.name: carousel
formats.notes: 2 to 20 items, images and/or videos; counts as one post toward 250/24h API limit

formats.name: poll
formats.notes: text-only post; 2-4 options, 1-25 chars each; not shared to fediverse

formats.name: ghost_post
formats.notes: text only via API; archived after 24 hours; replies go to messages; cannot be a reply
